$description: Page background assignments, mood only. Choices must belong to active slots in scene-slots.json. Unassigned case studies use the stable post rotation. Over Hood remains an experiment; Sauvie and Cottage Grove remain parked.
$homeSectionsDescription: Home's reading sections that aren't a case study, each over its own place while it's in view (the Work list's case studies use `projects`). Keys name the sections in src/pages/index.astro (`homeSection(key)`); the footer is home's own scene, bookending the hero. Mood only; swap a place by changing its id here.
$postsDescription: Posts rotate through these, stable per slug: a hash of the slug picks one, so a post keeps its scene when other posts are added or removed.
